title: ProtoKV: Streaming Video Understanding under Delayed Query with Summary-State Memory
title_zh: ProtoKV：面向延迟查询的流式视频理解摘要状态记忆
abstract_en: Streaming video understanding (SVU) must answer queries that arrive asynchronously while visual tokens stream continuously under strict GPU-memory and query-time latency budgets. A key challenge is delayed query: decisive cues may appear briefly, yet many subsequent updates occur before the query arrives, increasing the risk that those cues are evicted or diluted under bounded memory. We propose ProtoKV, a constant-footprint SVU memory that represents far history as a fixed-capacity summary state rather than retaining token instances. ProtoKV keeps an exact near-window KV cache and aggregates older content into a semantic-spatial prototype bank with residual statistics. At query time, each prototype is exposed through a bounded pseudo-token interface that is drop-in compatible with standard attention. Under matched budgets and comparable query-time cost, ProtoKV improves accuracy by up to 12.5 points over token-retention baselines on SVU benchmarks in the long-delay regime, with gains that grow as query delay increases.
abstract_zh: 本文研究流式视频理解（Streaming Video Understanding, SVU）中的延迟查询问题：视频视觉 token 持续到达，而查询可能异步且很晚才出现；在严格 GPU 显存和低查询延迟约束下，早期短暂但关键的视觉线索容易被淘汰或被后续信息稀释。作者提出 ProtoKV，一种固定内存占用的 SVU 记忆机制。它保留精确的近窗口 KV cache，并将更早历史压缩为语义-空间 prototype bank，同时维护 residual statistics。查询时，每个 prototype 通过有界 pseudo-token 接口暴露，可直接兼容标准 attention。在相同资源预算和相近查询开销下，ProtoKV 在长延迟场景的 SVU benchmark 上相比 token-retention 基线最高提升 12.5 个准确率点，且查询延迟越长收益越明显。
key_points_zh: 聚焦 SVU 的 delayed query 难题：关键视觉证据可能早已出现，但查询到来前经历大量更新，传统有限 KV 保留策略易丢失关键信息。
ProtoKV 采用 constant-footprint memory：近历史用精确 KV cache 保存，远历史不再保留 token 实例，而压缩为固定容量的 semantic-spatial prototype bank。
引入 residual statistics 以补充 prototype 对历史信息的近似表达，降低远程信息被过度压缩或语义稀释的风险。
查询阶段将 prototype 转换为 bounded pseudo-token，与标准 attention drop-in compatible，无需大幅改动现有模型推理接口。
在长延迟 SVU benchmark 中，相同预算下相较 token-retention baselines 最高提升 12.5 个准确率点，并且延迟越长优势越大。

llm_assessment.comment: A strong streaming-video memory paper with clear relevance to low-latency visual agents, though it is more an architectural improvement than a full agent interaction framework.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 这是一篇与低延迟视觉智能体高度相关的流式视频记忆论文，但更偏向架构改进而非完整的智能体交互框架。
